offering_description.value: Climb distributes third-party software and IT hardware to resellers, systems integrators and service providers. It also sells software and cloud solutions directly to organizations and helps them procure, deploy and manage those tools.

primary_products.value: Cybersecurity software; cloud infrastructure software; data management software; developer tools; IT hardware

primary_services.value: Software licensing advisory; cloud migration and deployment; managed cloud services

customer_segment.value: B2B: IT resellers, systems integrators, managed service providers and organizations buying technology for their own use

end_markets.value: IT distribution and services; enterprise IT; software development; cloud computing; cybersecurity

revenue_model.value: product sales: Third-party software licenses and IT hardware; subscription: Recurring third-party software and cloud subscriptions; service fees: Cloud deployment and ongoing management

value_chain_position.value: distributor: Sources software and hardware from technology vendors for resale to IT channel partners and business customers; service provider: Uses vendor software and cloud platforms to deliver deployment and management services to organizations

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland and continental Europe

specialization.value: related lines: IT distribution, direct software resale and cloud services

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: Value-added resellers, systems integrators and managed service providers; direct sales: Sales teams serving organizations that buy software and cloud solutions directly

regulatory_exposure.value: low: Commercial software resale subject to standard trade, licensing and data protection rules

notes: The current geographic reach beyond North America and Europe is uncertain.
